extension.summary: ממשק צפייה בסגנון נטפליקס, קל ומהיר
extension.description: A single lightweight add-on that brings together discovery (TMDB, Trakt, AniList), debrid playback (Real-Debrid, Premiumize, TorBox, AllDebrid), Israeli live TV and VOD, anime, and automatic Hebrew/English subtitles with an AI translation fallback. Built for weak devices: bounded concurrency, capped caches, no skin fork.
תוסף אחד וקל שמאחד גילוי תוכן, ניגון דרך שירותי דבריד, ערוצים ו-VOD ישראליים, אנימה, וכתוביות אוטומטיות בעברית ובאנגלית עם תרגום AI כגיבוי.
extension.news: v0.1.1 - Make an update reachable from the dashboard at all - Show which episode the button will act on, and make the cursor reachable - Run the checks on both kinds of machine, because that is where they differ - Choosing a source for an episode asked TMDB for the wrong thing entirely - Make the workflow able to run at all - Check the whole thing end to end, and report every problem rather than the first - List the Israeli catalogue before TMDB, and stay in Katan on Escape - Reach the anime seasons that have no name, and stop paying when it is not needed
